evidence: Inspected the complete body. It tests a context record, reads a status field and indexed records, branches on several status/flag combinations, performs helper lookups, dispatches through callbacks, and emits numeric context values; the operation is not specific enough to name safely from this body. Its only indexed caller is a forwarding wrapper that subtracts 0x98 from x0 and tail-calls it. decompiled/main/main_0111.c:17664-17905; decompiled/main/main_0111.c:19307-19311.

The complete body prepares three candidate/count arrays, iterates candidate indexes, queries records with find_candidate_record_for_tag and find_matching_strided_record, and passes a matched record to conditionally_place_player_on_waivers. The caller is a wrapper that preserves the input object and tail-calls this routine. decompiled/main/main_0054.c:25022-25295 (candidate queries at 25149-25275; waiver placement at 25284); decompiled/main/main_0054.c:24923-24934.

The body validates its inputs, searches/reads player attribute data and evaluates conditions before calling serialize_franchise_player_removal at decompiled/main/main_0050.c:25738; its return is a success flag. Caller f_7000be5ce4 loads removal-related record metadata, passes the parameters, checks the returned flag, and updates status fields. decompiled/main/main_0050.c:25473-25757; decompiled/main/main_0083.c:2957-3005.

The body requires a context flag at object+0x42a, obtains a 16-bit context value, adds it to the integer-converted player attribute 9, then maps the resulting score through descending thresholds (0xbb7, 0x9c3, 0x7cf, 0x6a3, 0x5db, 0x3e7) to small integer categories; invalid paths return -2. A caller stores the result into a 32-bit output field. decompiled/main/main_0112.c:34105-34206; decompiled/main/main_0111.c:26303-26308.

The body initializes the output to -1, resolves an attribute context, and either reads a direct player attribute (IDs through 0x75) or routes IDs 0x76-0x79 through a selector table to contextual component helpers; successful float values are converted to signed integers and stored through the output pointer. This routine had no indexed callers in the packet. decompiled/main/main_0125.c:48475-48557.

The body resolves a context pointer, gets player attribute 0, selects attribute 0x13, 0x16, or 0x17 for selector values 1, 2, or 3, then calls evaluate_contextual_attribute_scalar and a follow-up helper. Caller f_700113b338 invokes this helper for selector values 1, 2, and 3 in its contextual attribute selector branches. decompiled/main/main_0052.c:38080-38130; decompiled/main/main_0125.c:48559-48630.
